questions.question:

questions.solution:

__

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

I have completed the project.

options.text: The project was completed by me.
The project is being completed by me.
The project is completed by me.
The project has been completed by me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The project has been completed by me'**.

__
 
• The instructions given below should be followed while changing an assertive sentence to passive voice.

 
 
• Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well, if subject and object are pronouns. ('I' changes to 'me')
 
• Use preposition 'by' before the agent. (by me)
 
• Use an appropriate helping verb in passive form according to the tense of the active form. (Present perfect - has/have + V3)
 
 
• The given sentence is in the** present perfect tense**. In passive form, the subject will be **'the project'**, which is a **singular noun** and thus, it will take the** singular helping verb 'has'** followed by **'been'**. 
 
 
 
• Always use the third form of the main verb in passive form.
 
• At last line up the remaining part.
 
 

**Correct sentence__:*** The project has been completed by me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Past Perfect

Object + had + been + V3 + by + Subject

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution’.**

I __needs__ someone very strong to lift this heavy bag.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'need'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the simple present tense.
 
• According to subject-verb agreement, a singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
 
• Example: Ram goes to the temple every day.
 
• Example: They are painting the centre table.
 
 
 
• The 'V1 + s/es' form of the verb is used for third-person singular pronouns (he/she/it).
 
 
• Example: He goes to the playground every day.
 
 
 
• 'I' is the first person singular pronoun and it always takes V1 form of the verb.
 
• So, 'needs' should be replaced with 'need' to make the sentence correct.

Correct sentence__:* **I need someone very strong to lift this heavy bag.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• **'Am'** is the form of the **verb 'be'** that is used with the pronoun** 'I'**.

 
 
• **​Example:** I** am** an actor. (as a **stative verb**)
 
• **Example:** I **am** going to Mumbai tomorrow. (as a **helping verb**)

questions.question:
**__Direction__: Given below are four sentences which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order.**

**A: **Notify your card issuer that your card is missing and that it should be blocked.

**B:** Lastly, don’t forget to check your account for any unauthorised withdrawals.

**C:** A lost or stolen debit card can cause a lot of anxiety.

**D:** So, the first thing you need to do is to contact your bank.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'CDAB'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence C is independent of any other sentence and it introduces the matter of concern, i.e., **a lost or stolen debit card**.
 
• Sentence D should follow C as it tells about the** first thing **to be done if a debit card gets lost or stolen.
 
• Sentence A tells about the things to be informed to the card issuer at the bank. Hence, it follows D.
 
• Sentence B begins with the word **'lastly'**, which denotes that the sentence tells about the **final thing** to be done. So, B follows A.
 
• **Thus, the sequence becomes:** 
 
 
• **C: **A lost or stolen debit card can cause a lot of anxiety.
 
• **D:** So, the first thing you need to do is to contact your bank.
 
• **A:** Notify your card issuer that your card is missing and that it should be blocked.
 
• **B:** Lastly, don’t forget to check your account for any unauthorised withdrawals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the paragraph and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences of the paragraph (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants. Identify the pronouns connecting the sentences with each other.

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Nobody is allowed to entered the colony during the lockdown.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'to entered'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A verb is a word that denotes an action or a state.
 
• An infinitive is a non-finite verb that doesn't change according to the subject or tense.
 
 
• It follows the structure: to + base form of the verb.
 
• Example: I like to write in English.
 
• Example: He went to the market to buy some flowers.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, 'to' is the part of the infinitive, so it must take the base form of the verb.
 
• Thus, 'to entered' should be replaced with 'to enter' to make the sentence correct.

Correct sentence__: *Nobody is allowed to enter the colony during the lockdown.

 **Use**
 
 

 To (Preposition)

 A (Article)
